{{Top|leg}}
'''Damilini''' was a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] of the [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] people as well as one of the social castes of their race.

The Damilini were guarding [[Circle of Kavaan/Legends|Circle of Kavaan]] when [[Chinshassa]] was attacked, leading to a great hatred for the caste's failure.
